# LevelUp Ecosystem

> LevelUp Ecosystem is a web design and development studio based in San Diego, California, founded by Richelieu Bonte. It designs, builds, hosts and maintains custom websites for local businesses, brands and creators: mobile-first design, 24/7 online booking, Google visibility (local SEO, Google Maps) and security basics, all run from one client dashboard. It also operates LevelStudio, an AI-assisted website draft builder. English is the official language of the site; French is available as a translation.

Contact: contact@levelup-ecosystem.com. Prices and plans change over time: always use the pricing page for current figures.

## Services

- [Services](https://levelup-ecosystem.com/services): custom websites with online booking, website security checks, managed care plans (hosting, backups, updates), local SEO.
- [Pricing](https://levelup-ecosystem.com/pricing): fixed website project prices and monthly care plans.
- [Start a project](https://levelup-ecosystem.com/start-project): tell us about your project; every project starts with a free preview.
- [Contact](https://levelup-ecosystem.com/contact): ask a question or request a free preview.

## LevelStudio and templates

- [LevelStudio](https://levelup-ecosystem.com/studio): the AI website builder of LevelUp Ecosystem. Describe your business, answer a few guided questions and preview a website draft; LevelUp's engineers then deliver the production site. The app is at https://studio.levelup-ecosystem.com.
- [Projects and templates](https://levelup-ecosystem.com/projects): client work and three demo templates built by LevelUp: Miss Beauty (hair atelier, https://missbeauty.levelup-ecosystem.com/), Taste of Egypt Cafe (cafe and bakery, https://resto.levelup-ecosystem.com/) and LevelFlight (travel and visa advisory, https://travel.levelup-ecosystem.com/).
